name: Serizawa Miki
source:
Miki Serizawa is a female student at an all-girls school and Hiroko's only daughter. She and Hiroko are targeted by the protagonist, who rapes her as a tool to make her do what he wants. The protagonist then uses the videotape of their rape to blackmail her and train her.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071023044146/http://www.bpb.jp/products/r2/index.html]the official site[/url]]
